## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Fuse multi-source fire intelligence into operational decision support — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Predict fire behaviour from fuels, weather and topography for operations and planning — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Build, run and validate environmental forecast and scenario systems — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field — journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Analyze remotely sensed data to map and monitor environmental conditions — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Design decision-support products for actual decision contexts — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence — journey L2, senior L3, lead L3
- Conduct spatial analysis and modelling of environmental data — journey L2, senior L2, lead L3
- Plan smoke management for prescribed and managed fire within air quality requirements — senior L2, lead L2
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — journey L1, senior L1, lead L1
- Coordinate environmental response operations within incident command — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Supervise staff and volunteers in environmental work — senior L3, lead L4
